description:
### 

- As an end-user, when I am using the To-Do application dashboard, I want to quickly add tasks, view what needs to be done, mark tasks as complete, and delete items I no longer need so that I can stay organized and track my work.

### Context

- This is a clean and intuitive To-Do list interface.
- It is the core foundational feature for the productivity application.

### Acceptance criteria

- Given the user is on the To-Do application dashboard,
      - When the user types a task description into the input field and clicks the "Add Task" button (or presses Enter),
      - Then the new task should instantly appear at the top/bottom of the task list with an active (incomplete) status,
      - And the input field should automatically clear.
- Given the user has tasks in their list,
      - When the user clicks the "Delete" (trash icon) button next to a specific task,
      - Then the task is permanently removed from the list and UI.

### Other information

- The interface should allow users to mark tasks as complete.
